image_description: A close-up, side-profile photograph of a lionfish (Pterois) against a dark background. The fish displays characteristic red and white vertical stripes, large fan-like pectoral fins with elongated rays, and prominent dorsal spines fanning out from the back. The head is detailed with visible eyes and mouth structures.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Laterally compressed body with moderately sized proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The body shape is visibly laterally compressed (thin from side-to-side relative to height), matching the biological description of a lionfish.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Brightly striped coloration in red, white, brown, or black bands.
